column1: # Dictation models the build host serves as on-demand test services, one
# LaunchAgent and one port each. `lv-test-servers.sh install-speech-models`
# turns every row into a service named speechd-<name>; see scripts/mac/README.md.
# Keep the rows equal to SpeechModelCatalog.options (repo and revision):
# SpeechModelCatalogTests fails until they are. The voxtral row keeps port 8000
# and the pre-list trigger, label and log, and `speechd` stays its alias, so CI
# and an older build gate keep working.
